acceptanceCriteria: A1: The CI route remains dynamic across light, standard, and strict profiles and unknown or release-owned paths fail closed without a downgrade.
A2: Rust owns a read-only Contract-aware quality gate bound to repository, Contract, snapshot, route, Agent Risk, and preflight facts without writing .ai records.
A3: The Rust gate emits deterministic identity-bound JSON and yellow or red decisions exit non-zero.
A4: Pull-request CI invokes the Rust gate before repository commands for standard and strict routes while retaining existing Cargo/static shadow checks.
A5: Negative tests cover malformed, foreign, stale, symlink, policy-conflicting, manifest-tampered, route-tampered, and human-review-required inputs, plus read-only byte preservation.
A6: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese documentation describes the dynamic CI boundary, source-build versus immutable Release identity, and deferred workflow comparisons without overclaiming.
A7: Shared Runtime, explicit repository context, visible Outcome, and object/adopter isolation boundaries remain unchanged.
goal: Make CI consume the same Rust Contract and verification truth as the repository Runtime while retaining a dynamic, resource-aware quality route.
intent: The current Python quality route selects a light, standard, or strict profile but does not ask the Rust Runtime to validate the active Contract and policy-bound route before executing repository gates. Introduce one read-only Rust Contract-aware gate and connect it to CI so missing or contradictory governance facts stop before command execution, while existing Cargo/static checks remain as a shadow comparison.
outOfScope: full reference workflow graph and release-preflight parity
verification planner optimization and affected graph
global Agent/MCP configuration and source/V1 copying

scenarioCoverage.expected: missing, malformed, foreign, stale, symlink, or policy-conflicting Contract stops before repository gates
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Rust repository and CLI negative tests

scenarioCoverage.expected: docs-only, source, and strict/release changes select the same bounded profile and disagreeing Rust/Python receipts fail closed
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: quality route and CI workflow regression tests

scenarioCoverage.expected: the Rust CI gate emits a receipt without changing .ai Contract, Summary, evidence, or decision bytes
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: repository snapshot and byte-diff regression test

scenarioCoverage.expected: CI source-build identity remains distinct from immutable Release/adopter identity and no global Agent/MCP state is written
